PUBLIC RESPONSE: The question references Newton's color wheel (from Opticks), which divides the spectrum into seven sectors whose widths follow musical intervals in the Dorian mode and maps them to the diatonic scale. The seven colors in circumferential order are red–orange–yellow–green–blue–indigo–violet, corresponding to the notes D–E–F–G–A–B–C respectively.  
Yellow + blue produces green, so the arc lying between green and blue is the sector Newton assigns to the note A.  

(The same mapping is obtained if one starts the scale on any other pitch; relative to green = G the next sector is always A.)
